messages:
Emily: Big news  tiny head's up here 497 — were expecting a baby in August! 4763fb Wanted to share here first because you all have been such a great crew.
Noor: YAY EMILY!!! 389389 that's the best news omg. Huge congrats!!
Daniel: Congrats!! Any name leaks yet or are we in hush mode? :eyes: 
Emily: Hush mode 914 but we have a working nickname.
Zoe: Baby shower???? We need cake. and a tiny onesie. :baby: :cake: 
Emily: I would love that but understand not everyone is in SF. Maybe a hybrid shower? Thoughts?
PeopleOps: Love the idea. We can book a small conference room + Zoom hookup. Also we have a small shower budget for new parents 4b8.
Noor: Poll: react with :one: if weekday evening after 5pm works, :two: for weekend afternoon.
Daniel: :one: for me (weekday evenings are good)
Zoe: :two: weekend pls, my evenings are packed 
Emily: Noted. I'll put up a Doodle but open to whichever gets more votes.
Logistics: Quick note: office deliveries allowed between 10am-4pm. If you plan to drop off gifts, label with "Emily / Shower" and we can hold with reception.
CalendarBot: Poll created: "Emily's Baby Shower - Preferred Time" (link: https://doodle.com/survey/abc123). Expires in 72 hours.
Noor: Also remote-friendly gift ideas: we can do a group Amazon registry order + virtual card.
Daniel: If we collect $15 each we can buy that ridiculously cute baby swaddle and still get cake.
Zoe: Can someone with car bring the giant stuffed animal? Asking for the baby.
Emily: Lol no giant stuffed animals necessary 60a but I appreciate the enthusiasm. Registry link in DMs.
PeopleOps: If you want a printed card from the company, DM me the message and we'll print one to include.
Noor: I volunteer to make a tiny collage of office photos for the card. Submit GIFs/memes to me.
Daniel: I can bring coffee and non-dairy milk for the event.
Logistics: Note: cleaning crew picks up by 6pm on weekdays; please plan accordingly.
Zoe: Also can we do a "guess the baby stats" game? weight, length, date. Winner gets bragging rights.
Emily: Love that game. we'll do virtual and in-person entry.
CalendarBot: Reminder set: Event tentative until Doodle closed. Organizer: Emily.
Noor: Congrats again Em!!! so happy for you two 970
Emily: Thank you all, seriously. Means a lot. I'll post the final date once Doodle closes. 
Daniel: Sending good vibes and baby name suggestions in DM (most are terrible).
